title: A2 English Listening Practice - Good English Learners

segments.text: Hey English learners, welcome to this A2 English listening practice video.
segments.ipa: /heɪ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈlɝnərz ˈwɛlkəm tu ðɪs ə ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈlɪsənɪŋ ˈpræktəs ˈvɪdioʊ/

segments.text: I hope you're doing well and that you're ready to practice your listening.
segments.ipa: /aɪ hoʊp jʊr ˈduɪŋ wɛl ənd ðæt jʊr ˈrɛdi tu ˈpræktəs jɔr ˈlɪsənɪŋ/

segments.text: Today I want to talk about what makes a good English learner.
segments.ipa: /təˈdeɪ aɪ wɑnt tu tɔk əˈbaʊt wʌt meɪks ə ɡʊd ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈlɝnər/

segments.text: And of course, this is for any language, not just an English learner, but uh a good French learner,
segments.ipa: /ənd ʌv kɔrs ðɪs ɪz fɔr ˈɛni ˈlæŋɡwədʒ nɑt dʒʌst æn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈlɝnər bʌt ʌ ə ɡʊd frɛntʃ ˈlɝnər/

segments.text: a good Spanish learner.
segments.ipa: /ə ɡʊd ˈspænɪʃ ˈlɝnər/

segments.text: uh what makes a good language learner.
segments.ipa: /ʌ wʌt meɪks ə ɡʊd ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ˈlɝnər/

segments.text: So I want to talk about four things that make a good English learner.
segments.ipa: /soʊ aɪ wɑnt tu tɔk əˈbaʊt fɔr θɪŋz ðæt meɪk ə ɡʊd ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈlɝnər/

segments.text: There are many more things but I want to highlight four.
segments.ipa: /ðɛr ɑr ˈmɛni mɔr θɪŋz bʌt aɪ wɑnt tu ˈhaɪˌlaɪt fɔr/

segments.text: And uh before we continue on, if you can understand me in this video and it's pretty easy for you to understand what I'm saying,
segments.ipa: /ənd ʌ bɪˈfɔr wi kənˈtɪnju ɑn ɪf ju kæn ˌʌndərˈstænd mi ɪn ðɪs ˈvɪdioʊ ənd ɪts ˈprɪti ˈizi fɔr ju tu ˌʌndərˈstænd wʌt aɪm ˈseɪɪŋ/

segments.text: but you can't understand native speakers when they speak fast, then my listening training is for you.
segments.ipa: /bʌt ju kænt ˌʌndərˈstænd ˈneɪtɪv ˈspikərz wɛn ðeɪ spik fæst ðɛn maɪ ˈlɪsənɪŋ ˈtreɪnɪŋ ɪz fɔr ju/

segments.text: So, make sure you sign up for my membership and you'll get access to my listening practice seminars in which I help you understand native speakers when they speak fast.
segments.ipa: /soʊ meɪk ʃʊr ju saɪn ʌp fɔr maɪ ˈmɛmbərˌʃɪp ənd jul ɡɛt ˈækˌsɛs tu maɪ ˈlɪsənɪŋ ˈpræktəs ˈsɛməˌnɑrz ɪn wɪtʃ aɪ hɛlp ju ˌʌndərˈstænd ˈneɪtɪv ˈspikərz wɛn ðeɪ spik fæst/

segments.text: So, at the time of recording this, it's only $2 a month to sign up.
segments.ipa: /soʊ æt ðə taɪm ʌv rəˈkɔrdɪŋ ðɪs ɪts ˈoʊnli ə mʌnθ tu saɪn ʌp/

segments.text: It's cheap, affordable.
segments.ipa: /ɪts tʃip əˈfɔrdəbəl/

segments.text: You should do that.
segments.ipa: /ju ʃʊd du ðæt/

segments.text: The link is down below.
segments.ipa: /ðə lɪŋk ɪz daʊn bɪˈloʊ/

segments.text: Uh, do that so you can improve your listening.
segments.ipa: /ʌ du ðæt soʊ ju kæn ˌɪmˈpruv jɔr ˈlɪsənɪŋ/

segments.text: So let's talk about some different things that make a good English learner or language learner in general.
segments.ipa: /soʊ lɛts tɔk əˈbaʊt sʌm ˈdɪfərənt θɪŋz ðæt meɪk ə ɡʊd ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈlɝnər ɔr ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ˈlɝnər ɪn ˈdʒɛnərəl/

segments.text: So number one, an interest in other cultures. Okay?
segments.ipa: /soʊ ˈnʌmbər wʌn æn ˈɪntrəst ɪn ˈʌðər ˈkʌltʃərz ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: When you're interested in other cultures, this gives you a reason.
segments.ipa: /wɛn jʊr ˈɪntrəstɪd ɪn ˈʌðər ˈkʌltʃərz ðɪs ɡɪvz ju ə ˈrizən/

segments.text: This gives you motivation to learn the language that you're learning.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs ɡɪvz ju ˌmoʊtəˈveɪʃən tu lɝn ðə ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ðæt jʊr ˈlɝnɪŋ/

segments.text: Even if it's challenging, even if you're having trouble, uh it's difficult for you,
segments.ipa: /ˈivɪn ɪf ɪts ˈtʃæləndʒɪŋ ˈivɪn ɪf jʊr ˈhævɪŋ ˈtrʌbəl ʌ ɪts ˈdɪfəkəlt fɔr ju/

segments.text: you hit a plateau perhaps.
segments.ipa: /ju hɪt ə plæˈtoʊ pərˈhæps/

segments.text: Regardless of these things, if you have a real interest, a genuine interest in other cultures and specifically the culture that speaks the language that you're learning,
segments.ipa: /rəˈɡɑrdləs ʌv ðiz θɪŋz ɪf ju hæv ə ril ˈɪntrəst ə ˈdʒɛnjəwən ˈɪntrəst ɪn ˈʌðər ˈkʌltʃərz ənd spəˈsɪfɪkli ðə ˈkʌltʃər ðæt spiks ðə ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ðæt jʊr ˈlɝnɪŋ/

segments.text: in your case, English.
segments.ipa: /ɪn jɔr keɪs ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ/

segments.text: So perhaps it's American culture, Canadian culture, Australian culture, British culture, whatever.
segments.ipa: /soʊ pərˈhæps ɪts əˈmɛrəkən ˈkʌltʃər kəˈneɪdiən ˈkʌltʃər ɔˈstreɪljən ˈkʌltʃər ˈbrɪtɪʃ ˈkʌltʃər ˌwʌˈtɛvər/

segments.text: If you have that intense interest in that culture, it gives you a reason.
segments.ipa: /ɪf ju hæv ðæt ˌɪnˈtɛns ˈɪntrəst ɪn ðæt ˈkʌltʃər ɪt ɡɪvz ju ə ˈrizən/

segments.text: And having a reason to learn a language is super powerful.
segments.ipa: /ənd ˈhævɪŋ ə ˈrizən tu lɝn ə ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ɪz ˈsupər ˈpaʊərfəl/

segments.text: This makes all the difference. Okay?
segments.ipa: /ðɪs meɪks ɔl ðə ˈdɪfərəns ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: When you have a reason, you actually uh want to do it.
segments.ipa: /wɛn ju hæv ə ˈrizən ju ˈækˌtʃuəli ʌ wɑnt tu du ɪt/

segments.text: You don't just have to learn the language, but you want to.
segments.ipa: /ju doʊnt dʒʌst hæv tu lɝn ðə ˈlæŋɡwədʒ bʌt ju wɑnt tu/

segments.text: That's super uh helpful and motivating.
segments.ipa: /ðæts ˈsupər ʌ ˈhɛlpfəl ənd ˈmoʊtəˌveɪtɪŋ/

segments.text: Uh and it makes it easier I think.
segments.ipa: /ʌ ənd ɪt meɪks ɪt ˈiziər aɪ θɪŋk/

segments.text: uh it makes you have less resistance uh when you encounter differences when you see that uh the language that you're learning uh English for example has these
segments.ipa: /ʌ ɪt meɪks ju hæv lɛs rɪˈzɪstəns ʌ wɛn ju ɪnˈkaʊntər ˈdɪfərənsɪz wɛn ju si ðæt ʌ ðə ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ðæt jʊr ˈlɝnɪŋ ʌ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ fɔr ɪɡˈzæmpəl hæz ðiz/

segments.text: linguistic differences that you don't quite understand for a lot of people that can make it hard for them to continue on with their language learning.
segments.ipa: /lɪŋɡˈwɪstɪk ˈdɪfərənsɪz ðæt ju doʊnt kwaɪt ˌʌndərˈstænd fɔr ə lɑt ʌv ˈpipəl ðæt kæn meɪk ɪt hɑrd fɔr ðɛm tu kənˈtɪnju ɑn wɪð ðɛr ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ˈlɝnɪŋ/

segments.text: But if you're interested in other cultures, the culture that speaks the language that you're learning,
segments.ipa: /bʌt ɪf jʊr ˈɪntrəstɪd ɪn ˈʌðər ˈkʌltʃərz ðə ˈkʌltʃər ðæt spiks ðə ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ðæt jʊr ˈlɝnɪŋ/

segments.text: you are more likely to accept these differences.
segments.ipa: /ju ɑr mɔr ˈlaɪkli tu ækˈsɛpt ðiz ˈdɪfərənsɪz/

segments.text: These differences aren't necessarily a problem.
segments.ipa: /ðiz ˈdɪfərənsɪz ˈɑrənt ˌnɛsəˈsɛrəli ə ˈprɑbləm/

segments.text: You're actually kind of interested in the differences just like you're interested in the different culture.
segments.ipa: /jʊr ˈækˌtʃuəli kaɪnd ʌv ˈɪntrəstɪd ɪn ðə ˈdɪfərənsɪz dʒʌst laɪk jʊr ˈɪntrəstɪd ɪn ðə ˈdɪfərənt ˈkʌltʃər/

segments.text: So that helps a lot.
segments.ipa: /soʊ ðæt hɛlps ə lɑt/

segments.text: It helped me a lot when I was learning Spanish.
segments.ipa: /ɪt hɛlpt mi ə lɑt wɛn aɪ wɑz ˈlɝnɪŋ ˈspænɪʃ/

segments.text: At that time, I was super interested in Latin America, in Mexico in particular.
segments.ipa: /æt ðæt taɪm aɪ wɑz ˈsupər ˈɪntrəstɪd ɪn ˈlætən əˈmɛrəkə ɪn ˈmɛksəˌkoʊ ɪn pərˈtɪkjələr/

segments.text: I was super excited about discovering that culture, getting to know the different aspects of life and culture and it helped me uh accept the differences that I
segments.ipa: /aɪ wɑz ˈsupər ɪkˈsaɪtəd əˈbaʊt dɪˈskʌvərɪŋ ðæt ˈkʌltʃər ˈɡɛtɪŋ tu noʊ ðə ˈdɪfərənt ˈæˌspɛkts ʌv laɪf ənd ˈkʌltʃər ənd ɪt hɛlpt mi ʌ ækˈsɛpt ðə ˈdɪfərənsɪz ðæt aɪ/

segments.text: was encountering uh with the Spanish language.
segments.ipa: /wɑz ɛnˈkaʊntərɪŋ ʌ wɪð ðə ˈspænɪʃ ˈlæŋɡwədʒ/

segments.text: So uh that was uh something that really helped me.
segments.ipa: /soʊ ʌ ðæt wɑz ʌ ˈsʌmθɪŋ ðæt ˈrɪli hɛlpt mi/

segments.text: It really aided me in my language learning.
segments.ipa: /ɪt ˈrɪli ˈeɪdəd mi ɪn maɪ ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ˈlɝnɪŋ/

segments.text: And for example, if you're looking to become more interested in US culture, if you want to learn more and um get excited about learning about the different
segments.ipa: /ənd fɔr ɪɡˈzæmpəl ɪf jʊr ˈlʊkɪŋ tu bɪˈkʌm mɔr ˈɪntrəstɪd ɪn ʌs ˈkʌltʃər ɪf ju wɑnt tu lɝn mɔr ənd ʌm ɡɛt ɪkˈsaɪtəd əˈbaʊt ˈlɝnɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðə ˈdɪfərənt/

segments.text: states and cities in the US, I encourage you to check out my US Conversations podcast in which I talk to different English teachers from around the country
segments.ipa: /steɪts ənd ˈsɪtiz ɪn ðə ʌs aɪ ɛnˈkɝɪdʒ ju tu tʃɛk aʊt maɪ ʌs ˌkɑnvərˈseɪʃənz ˈpɔdˌkæst ɪn wɪtʃ aɪ tɔk tu ˈdɪfərənt ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈtitʃərz frʌm ərˈaʊnd ðə ˈkʌntri/

segments.text: about their state, their city.
segments.ipa: /əˈbaʊt ðɛr steɪt ðɛr ˈsɪti/

segments.text: It's a lot of fun.
segments.ipa: /ɪts ə lɑt ʌv fʌn/

segments.text: So, that link is down below.
segments.ipa: /soʊ ðæt lɪŋk ɪz daʊn bɪˈloʊ/

segments.text: Next, uh the thing I also the next thing I wanted to mention was that patience really helps someone be a better language learner. Okay?
segments.ipa: /nɛkst ʌ ðə θɪŋ aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ ðə nɛkst θɪŋ aɪ ˈwɔntɪd tu ˈmɛnʃən wɑz ðæt ˈpeɪʃəns ˈrɪli hɛlps ˈsʌmˌwʌn bi ə ˈbɛtər ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ˈlɝnər ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: You shouldn't be discouraged about how long it takes.
segments.ipa: /ju ˈʃʊdənt bi dɪˈskɝədʒd əˈbaʊt haʊ lɔŋ ɪt teɪks/

segments.text: Learning a language takes a long time.
segments.ipa: /ˈlɝnɪŋ ə ˈlæŋɡwədʒ teɪks ə lɔŋ taɪm/

segments.text: Let's be honest, okay?
segments.ipa: /lɛts bi ˈɑnəst ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: We should be realistic about our expectations.
segments.ipa: /wi ʃʊd bi ˌriəˈlɪstɪk əˈbaʊt ˈaʊər ˌɛkspɛkˈteɪʃənz/

segments.text: we shouldn't expect to become fluent quickly because that's just simply not the case. Okay?
segments.ipa: /wi ˈʃʊdənt ɪkˈspɛkt tu bɪˈkʌm ˈfluənt ˈkwɪkli bɪˈkɔz ðæts dʒʌst ˈsɪmpli nɑt ðə keɪs ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: Uh it's important to uh understand this and to be patient with yourself and to be patient during this process.
segments.ipa: /ʌ ɪts ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt tu ʌ ˌʌndərˈstænd ðɪs ənd tu bi ˈpeɪʃənt wɪð jərˈsɛlf ənd tu bi ˈpeɪʃənt ˈdʊrɪŋ ðɪs ˈprɑˌsɛs/

segments.text: Uh don't force things.
segments.ipa: /ʌ doʊnt fɔrs θɪŋz/

segments.text: Don't try to force it to go super super fast.
segments.ipa: /doʊnt traɪ tu fɔrs ɪt tu ɡoʊ ˈsupər ˈsupər fæst/

segments.text: Of course, try to uh do as much as you can so that you can learn more quickly in general.
segments.ipa: /ʌv kɔrs traɪ tu ʌ du æz mʌtʃ æz ju kæn soʊ ðæt ju kæn lɝn mɔr ˈkwɪkli ɪn ˈdʒɛnərəl/

segments.text: Obviously, you can do that, but don't force it.
segments.ipa: /ˈɑbviəsli ju kæn du ðæt bʌt doʊnt fɔrs ɪt/

segments.text: Don't get too anxious about needing to speak really quickly or needing to understand everything really quickly.
segments.ipa: /doʊnt ɡɛt tu ˈæŋkʃəs əˈbaʊt ˈnidɪŋ tu spik ˈrɪli ˈkwɪkli ɔr ˈnidɪŋ tu ˌʌndərˈstænd ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ˈrɪli ˈkwɪkli/

segments.text: Be patient, right?
segments.ipa: /bi ˈpeɪʃənt raɪt/

segments.text: If you put in the work and you're regular with it, it will come. Okay?
segments.ipa: /ɪf ju pʊt ɪn ðə wɝk ənd jʊr ˈrɛɡjələr wɪð ɪt ɪt wɪl kʌm ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: So, don't force it.
segments.ipa: /soʊ doʊnt fɔrs ɪt/

segments.text: Be patient with yourself.
segments.ipa: /bi ˈpeɪʃənt wɪð jərˈsɛlf/

segments.text: Uh you're going to make the same mistakes again and again and again, hundreds of times in some cases. Okay?
segments.ipa: /ʌ jʊr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu meɪk ðə seɪm mɪˈsteɪks əˈɡɛn ənd əˈɡɛn ənd əˈɡɛn ˈhʌndrədz ʌv taɪmz ɪn sʌm ˈkeɪsəz ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: Uh that actually happens.
segments.ipa: /ʌ ðæt ˈækˌtʃuəli ˈhæpənz/

segments.text: Sometimes it literally takes like 200 times before you finally say it right. Okay?
segments.ipa: /səmˈtaɪmz ɪt ˈlɪtərəli teɪks laɪk taɪmz bɪˈfɔr ju ˈfaɪnəli seɪ ɪt raɪt ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: Most of the time you can probably uh learn things more quickly than that.
segments.ipa: /moʊst ʌv ðə taɪm ju kæn ˈprɑbəˌbli ʌ lɝn θɪŋz mɔr ˈkwɪkli ðæn ðæt/

segments.text: But sometimes you make the same mistake many times, dozens of times. Okay?
segments.ipa: /bʌt səmˈtaɪmz ju meɪk ðə seɪm mɪˈsteɪk ˈmɛni taɪmz ˈdʌzənz ʌv taɪmz ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: And you forget things. All right?
segments.ipa: /ənd ju fərˈɡɛt θɪŋz ɔl raɪt/

segments.text: Uh we forget things that we learned in the past.
segments.ipa: /ʌ wi fərˈɡɛt θɪŋz ðæt wi lɝnd ɪn ðə pæst/

segments.text: And so you're going to make the same mistakes again and again.
segments.ipa: /ənd soʊ jʊr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu meɪk ðə seɪm mɪˈsteɪks əˈɡɛn ənd əˈɡɛn/

segments.text: You're going to forget things that you learned.
segments.ipa: /jʊr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu fərˈɡɛt θɪŋz ðæt ju lɝnd/

segments.text: So, you need to be patient with yourself.
segments.ipa: /soʊ ju nid tu bi ˈpeɪʃənt wɪð jərˈsɛlf/

segments.text: Be patient during this process.
segments.ipa: /bi ˈpeɪʃənt ˈdʊrɪŋ ðɪs ˈprɑˌsɛs/

segments.text: People often give up too soon because they're not patient, right?
segments.ipa: /ˈpipəl ˈɔfən ɡɪv ʌp tu sun bɪˈkɔz ðɛr nɑt ˈpeɪʃənt raɪt/

segments.text: They just assume that because it's not easy for them, because it's taking a while.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ dʒʌst əˈsum ðæt bɪˈkɔz ɪts nɑt ˈizi fɔr ðɛm bɪˈkɔz ɪts ˈteɪkɪŋ ə waɪl/

segments.text: This means that they are not talented at language learning.
segments.ipa: /ðɪs minz ðæt ðeɪ ɑr nɑt ˈtæləntɪd æt ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ˈlɝnɪŋ/

segments.text: It's just not for them, right?
segments.ipa: /ɪts dʒʌst nɑt fɔr ðɛm raɪt/

segments.text: uh they come to this conclusion but in reality they're just not patient. Right?
segments.ipa: /ʌ ðeɪ kʌm tu ðɪs kənˈkluʒən bʌt ɪn ˌriˈæləˌti ðɛr dʒʌst nɑt ˈpeɪʃənt raɪt/

segments.text: I've been learning languages for years.
segments.ipa: /aɪv bɪn ˈlɝnɪŋ ˈlæŋɡwədʒəz fɔr jɪrz/

segments.text: It's a slow process in most cases unless you are just forced to learn really quickly for some reason.
segments.ipa: /ɪts ə sloʊ ˈprɑˌsɛs ɪn moʊst ˈkeɪsəz ənˈlɛs ju ɑr dʒʌst fɔrst tu lɝn ˈrɪli ˈkwɪkli fɔr sʌm ˈrizən/

segments.text: Sometimes that happens but most of the time that doesn't.
segments.ipa: /səmˈtaɪmz ðæt ˈhæpənz bʌt moʊst ʌv ðə taɪm ðæt ˈdʌzənt/

segments.text: You have time.
segments.ipa: /ju hæv taɪm/

segments.text: you don't need to learn in two months or else uh your life is over.
segments.ipa: /ju doʊnt nid tu lɝn ɪn tu mʌnθs ɔr ɛls ʌ jɔr laɪf ɪz ˈoʊvər/

segments.text: That's usually not the case and because of that it takes a while. Okay.
segments.ipa: /ðæts ˈjuʒəwəli nɑt ðə keɪs ənd bɪˈkɔz ʌv ðæt ɪt teɪks ə waɪl ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: So, uh a good language learner is patient during the language learning process and they're patient with themselves. Okay.
segments.ipa: /soʊ ʌ ə ɡʊd ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ˈlɝnər ɪz ˈpeɪʃənt ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ˈlɝnɪŋ ˈprɑˌsɛs ənd ðɛr ˈpeɪʃənt wɪð ðɛmˈsɛlvz ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: Next, a good language learner has humility.
segments.ipa: /nɛkst ə ɡʊd ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ˈlɝnər hæz hjuˈmɪlɪti/

segments.text: They are humble.
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ ɑr ˈhʌmbəl/

segments.text: So, what does this mean?
segments.ipa: /soʊ wʌt dʌz ðɪs min/

segments.text: They're willing to be like a small child, okay?
segments.ipa: /ðɛr ˈwɪlɪŋ tu bi laɪk ə smɔl tʃaɪld ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: They're willing to be like a little kid who's just learning something for the first time because you're going to get corrected.
segments.ipa: /ðɛr ˈwɪlɪŋ tu bi laɪk ə ˈlɪtəl kɪd huz dʒʌst ˈlɝnɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ fɔr ðə fɝst taɪm bɪˈkɔz jʊr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ɡɛt kərˈɛktəd/

segments.text: You're going to say things that quite honestly sound funny or sometimes even ridiculous. Okay?
segments.ipa: /jʊr ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu seɪ θɪŋz ðæt kwaɪt ˈɑnəstli saʊnd ˈfʌni ɔr səmˈtaɪmz ˈivɪn rɪˈdɪkjələs ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: I don't mean that in a bad way.
segments.ipa: /aɪ doʊnt min ðæt ɪn ə bæd weɪ/

segments.text: We all go through that as language learners.
segments.ipa: /wi ɔl ɡoʊ θru ðæt æz ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ˈlɝnərz/

segments.text: We say ridiculous things and it's funny.
segments.ipa: /wi seɪ rɪˈdɪkjələs θɪŋz ənd ɪts ˈfʌni/

segments.text: There's nothing wrong with that. Okay.
segments.ipa: /ðɛrz ˈnʌθɪŋ rɔŋ wɪð ðæt ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: Uh I have young children.
segments.ipa: /ʌ aɪ hæv jʌŋ ˈtʃɪldrən/

segments.text: My son says some pretty funny, sometimes ridiculous things and it's funny and we laugh at it and he laughs at it.
segments.ipa: /maɪ sʌn sɛz sʌm ˈprɪti ˈfʌni səmˈtaɪmz rɪˈdɪkjələs θɪŋz ənd ɪts ˈfʌni ənd wi læf æt ɪt ənd hi læfs æt ɪt/

segments.text: He doesn't get all offended that we're laughing at something silly that he said wrong or whatever.
segments.ipa: /hi ˈdʌzənt ɡɛt ɔl əˈfɛndəd ðæt wir ˈlæfɪŋ æt ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈsɪli ðæt hi sɛd rɔŋ ɔr ˌwʌˈtɛvər/

segments.text: We laugh at it and we make it a positive experience.
segments.ipa: /wi læf æt ɪt ənd wi meɪk ɪt ə ˈpɑzətɪv ɪkˈspɪriəns/

segments.text: My son thinks it's hilarious when he accidentally says the wrong word, for example.
segments.ipa: /maɪ sʌn θɪŋks ɪts hɪˈlɛriəs wɛn hi ˌæksəˈdɛntəli sɛz ðə rɔŋ wɝd fɔr ɪɡˈzæmpəl/

segments.text: And that's how we need to be as language learners. Okay?
segments.ipa: /ənd ðæts haʊ wi nid tu bi æz ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ˈlɝnərz ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: We need to uh laugh at ourselves, be humble, not expect to be uh really good and um expect to be able to say everything we want to
segments.ipa: /wi nid tu ʌ læf æt aʊərˈsɛlvz bi ˈhʌmbəl nɑt ɪkˈspɛkt tu bi ʌ ˈrɪli ɡʊd ənd ʌm ɪkˈspɛkt tu bi ˈeɪbəl tu seɪ ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ wi wɑnt tu/

segments.text: say naturally from the beginning.
segments.ipa: /seɪ ˈnætʃərəli frʌm ðə bɪˈɡɪnɪŋ/

segments.text: It doesn't work like that.
segments.ipa: /ɪt ˈdʌzənt wɝk laɪk ðæt/

segments.text: We need to humble ourselves and understand that we need help.
segments.ipa: /wi nid tu ˈhʌmbəl aʊərˈsɛlvz ənd ˌʌndərˈstænd ðæt wi nid hɛlp/

segments.text: We need to get corrected.
segments.ipa: /wi nid tu ɡɛt kərˈɛktəd/

segments.text: We need to ask other people for help perhaps when we're learning a language.
segments.ipa: /wi nid tu æsk ˈʌðər ˈpipəl fɔr hɛlp pərˈhæps wɛn wir ˈlɝnɪŋ ə ˈlæŋɡwədʒ/

segments.text: We need to not take ourselves too seriously.
segments.ipa: /wi nid tu nɑt teɪk aʊərˈsɛlvz tu ˈsɪriəsli/

segments.text: And like I said, we need to laugh at our mistakes. Okay?
segments.ipa: /ənd laɪk aɪ sɛd wi nid tu læf æt ˈaʊər mɪˈsteɪks ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: If you can't laugh at your mistakes, language learning is not going to be fun. Okay?
segments.ipa: /ɪf ju kænt læf æt jɔr mɪˈsteɪks ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ˈlɝnɪŋ ɪz nɑt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu bi fʌn ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: It's going to be pretty stressful.
segments.ipa: /ɪts ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu bi ˈprɪti ˈstrɛsfəl/

segments.text: And when language learning is stressful, it's often not effective.
segments.ipa: /ənd wɛn ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ˈlɝnɪŋ ɪz ˈstrɛsfəl ɪts ˈɔfən nɑt ɪˈfɛktɪv/

segments.text: uh you often don't progress the way you would like to progress.
segments.ipa: /ʌ ju ˈɔfən doʊnt ˈprɑˌɡrɛs ðə weɪ ju wʊd laɪk tu ˈprɑˌɡrɛs/

segments.text: So laugh at yourself.
segments.ipa: /soʊ læf æt jərˈsɛlf/

segments.text: Be like a small child except that uh you uh are not at the level as other people or as native speakers.
segments.ipa: /bi laɪk ə smɔl tʃaɪld ɪkˈsɛpt ðæt ʌ ju ʌ ɑr nɑt æt ðə ˈlɛvəl æz ˈʌðər ˈpipəl ɔr æz ˈneɪtɪv ˈspikərz/

segments.text: Okay, all of that is important.
segments.ipa: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ ɔl ʌv ðæt ɪz ˌɪmˈpɔrtənt/

segments.text: All right, humility.
segments.ipa: /ɔl raɪt hjuˈmɪlɪti/

segments.text: Lastly, a good language learner is willing to challenge themselves. Okay?
segments.ipa: /ˈlæstli ə ɡʊd ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ˈlɝnər ɪz ˈwɪlɪŋ tu ˈtʃæləndʒ ðɛmˈsɛlvz ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: They need to be able to use content that is actually challenging for them. Okay?
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ nid tu bi ˈeɪbəl tu jus ˈkɑntɛnt ðæt ɪz ˈækˌtʃuəli ˈtʃæləndʒɪŋ fɔr ðɛm ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: Content that's a little above your level, that contains things that are hard to understand perhaps.
segments.ipa: /ˈkɑntɛnt ðæts ə ˈlɪtəl əˈbʌv jɔr ˈlɛvəl ðæt kənˈteɪnz θɪŋz ðæt ɑr hɑrd tu ˌʌndərˈstænd pərˈhæps/

segments.text: Uh and you do this so that you can reach that level.
segments.ipa: /ʌ ənd ju du ðɪs soʊ ðæt ju kæn ritʃ ðæt ˈlɛvəl/

segments.text: It's like going to the gym.
segments.ipa: /ɪts laɪk ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ðə dʒɪm/

segments.text: If you always lift the same amount of weight because it's comfortable for you,
segments.ipa: /ɪf ju ˈɔlˌweɪz lɪft ðə seɪm əˈmaʊnt ʌv weɪt bɪˈkɔz ɪts ˈkʌmfərtəbəl fɔr ju/

segments.text: then you're not going to get stronger and lift heavier weight.
segments.ipa: /ðɛn jʊr nɑt ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu ɡɛt ˈstrɔŋər ənd lɪft ˈhɛviər weɪt/

segments.text: You have to put more weight on the bar or whatever and try that even though it's challenging in order to become accustomed to that new weight.
segments.ipa: /ju hæv tu pʊt mɔr weɪt ɑn ðə bɑr ɔr ˌwʌˈtɛvər ənd traɪ ðæt ˈivɪn ðoʊ ɪts ˈtʃæləndʒɪŋ ɪn ˈɔrdər tu bɪˈkʌm əˈkʌstəmd tu ðæt nu weɪt/

segments.text: The same thing goes for language learning.
segments.ipa: /ðə seɪm θɪŋ ɡoʊz fɔr ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ˈlɝnɪŋ/

segments.text: Okay, you need to challenge yourself and uh use content that's a little bit harder than what you're comfortable with and that will get you accustomed to content
segments.ipa: /ˌoʊˈkeɪ ju nid tu ˈtʃæləndʒ jərˈsɛlf ənd ʌ jus ˈkɑntɛnt ðæts ə ˈlɪtəl bɪt ˈhɑrdər ðæn wʌt jʊr ˈkʌmfərtəbəl wɪð ənd ðæt wɪl ɡɛt ju əˈkʌstəmd tu ˈkɑntɛnt/

segments.text: at that level. Okay.
segments.ipa: /æt ðæt ˈlɛvəl ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: Uh, a really practical example of this is that many people just use my normal podcast episodes or perhaps they use uh my YouTube videos in which I
segments.ipa: /ʌ ə ˈrɪli ˈpræktəkəl ɪɡˈzæmpəl ʌv ðɪs ɪz ðæt ˈmɛni ˈpipəl dʒʌst jus maɪ ˈnɔrməl ˈpɔdˌkæst ˈɛpəˌsoʊdz ɔr pərˈhæps ðeɪ jus ʌ maɪ ˈjutˌjub ˈvɪdioʊz ɪn wɪtʃ aɪ/

segments.text: speak slowly and they refuse to start listening to more advanced content.
segments.ipa: /spik ˈsloʊli ənd ðeɪ rəfˈjuz tu stɑrt ˈlɪsənɪŋ tu mɔr ədˈvænst ˈkɑntɛnt/

segments.text: they refuse to listen to my advanced episodes, for example, or they just put that off and say,
segments.ipa: /ðeɪ rəfˈjuz tu ˈlɪsən tu maɪ ədˈvænst ˈɛpəˌsoʊdz fɔr ɪɡˈzæmpəl ɔr ðeɪ dʒʌst pʊt ðæt ɔf ənd seɪ/

segments.text: "I'll I'll do that later.
segments.ipa: /aɪl aɪl du ðæt ˈleɪtər/

segments.text: I'll do that next year." Right?
segments.ipa: /aɪl du ðæt nɛkst jɪr raɪt/

segments.text: And they don't do what they should be doing, which is challenge challenging themselves to actually um get accustomed to what fast English sounds like. Okay?
segments.ipa: /ənd ðeɪ doʊnt du wʌt ðeɪ ʃʊd bi ˈduɪŋ wɪtʃ ɪz ˈtʃæləndʒ ˈtʃæləndʒɪŋ ðɛmˈsɛlvz tu ˈækˌtʃuəli ʌm ɡɛt əˈkʌstəmd tu wʌt fæst ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ saʊndz laɪk ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: If that's your case, if you're comfortable with uh the way I'm talking now,
segments.ipa: /ɪf ðæts jɔr keɪs ɪf jʊr ˈkʌmfərtəbəl wɪð ʌ ðə weɪ aɪm ˈtɔkɪŋ naʊ/

segments.text: if you're comfortable with my podcast episodes and you just want to stay here,
segments.ipa: /ɪf jʊr ˈkʌmfərtəbəl wɪð maɪ ˈpɔdˌkæst ˈɛpəˌsoʊdz ənd ju dʒʌst wɑnt tu steɪ hir/

segments.text: that's going to cause your improvement to um go slowly. Okay?
segments.ipa: /ðæts ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu kɑz jɔr ˌɪmˈpruvmənt tu ʌm ɡoʊ ˈsloʊli ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: It's going to cause you to um not progress as quickly as you would like to.
segments.ipa: /ɪts ˈɡoʊɪŋ tu kɑz ju tu ʌm nɑt ˈprɑˌɡrɛs æz ˈkwɪkli æz ju wʊd laɪk tu/

segments.text: uh you have to challenge yourself. Okay?
segments.ipa: /ʌ ju hæv tu ˈtʃæləndʒ jərˈsɛlf ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: So for example, if like I said, if this content is easy for you,
segments.ipa: /soʊ fɔr ɪɡˈzæmpəl ɪf laɪk aɪ sɛd ɪf ðɪs ˈkɑntɛnt ɪz ˈizi fɔr ju/

segments.text: start using more advanced content.
segments.ipa: /stɑrt ˈjuzɪŋ mɔr ədˈvænst ˈkɑntɛnt/

segments.text: Use my advanced episodes or use other content that is more challenging, right?
segments.ipa: /jus maɪ ədˈvænst ˈɛpəˌsoʊdz ɔr jus ˈʌðər ˈkɑntɛnt ðæt ɪz mɔr ˈtʃæləndʒɪŋ raɪt/

segments.text: And then of course uh you need to eventually start to listen to more than one person talking, right?
segments.ipa: /ənd ðɛn ʌv kɔrs ʌ ju nid tu ɪˈvɛntʃəwəli stɑrt tu ˈlɪsən tu mɔr ðæn wʌn ˈpɝsən ˈtɔkɪŋ raɪt/

segments.text: That's what I always talk about when I talk about my US Conversations podcast.
segments.ipa: /ðæts wʌt aɪ ˈɔlˌweɪz tɔk əˈbaʊt wɛn aɪ tɔk əˈbaʊt maɪ ʌs ˌkɑnvərˈseɪʃənz ˈpɔdˌkæst/

segments.text: Uh that gives you the opportunity to listen to two people talking and not just one.
segments.ipa: /ʌ ðæt ɡɪvz ju ðə ˌɑpərˈtunəti tu ˈlɪsən tu tu ˈpipəl ˈtɔkɪŋ ənd nɑt dʒʌst wʌn/

segments.text: It helps you become accustomed to uh that type of situation where there's more than one person talking.
segments.ipa: /ɪt hɛlps ju bɪˈkʌm əˈkʌstəmd tu ʌ ðæt taɪp ʌv ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən wɛr ðɛrz mɔr ðæn wʌn ˈpɝsən ˈtɔkɪŋ/

segments.text: And even just these videos, I title them A1 or A2.
segments.ipa: /ənd ˈivɪn dʒʌst ðiz ˈvɪdioʊz aɪ ˈtaɪtəl ðɛm ə ɔr ə/

segments.text: Of course, I say things and I use language in these videos that is a little bit more challenging than A1 or A2.
segments.ipa: /ʌv kɔrs aɪ seɪ θɪŋz ənd aɪ jus ˈlæŋɡwədʒ ɪn ðiz ˈvɪdioʊz ðæt ɪz ə ˈlɪtəl bɪt mɔr ˈtʃæləndʒɪŋ ðæn ə ɔr ə/

segments.text: But that's the point.
segments.ipa: /bʌt ðæts ðə pɔɪnt/

segments.text: The point of an A2 video, an A2 listening practice video, is to help you reach a higher level. Right?
segments.ipa: /ðə pɔɪnt ʌv æn ə ˈvɪdioʊ æn ə ˈlɪsənɪŋ ˈpræktəs ˈvɪdioʊ ɪz tu hɛlp ju ritʃ ə ˈhaɪər ˈlɛvəl raɪt/

segments.text: If you're at an A2 level, you should be listening to content that's higher than that level,
segments.ipa: /ɪf jʊr æt æn ə ˈlɛvəl ju ʃʊd bi ˈlɪsənɪŋ tu ˈkɑntɛnt ðæts ˈhaɪər ðæn ðæt ˈlɛvəl/

segments.text: a little bit higher, so that you can become accustomed to that higher level content and reach that level.
segments.ipa: /ə ˈlɪtəl bɪt ˈhaɪər soʊ ðæt ju kæn bɪˈkʌm əˈkʌstəmd tu ðæt ˈhaɪər ˈlɛvəl ˈkɑntɛnt ənd ritʃ ðæt ˈlɛvəl/

segments.text: So, we're at the end of the video.
segments.ipa: /soʊ wir æt ðə ɛnd ʌv ðə ˈvɪdioʊ/

segments.text: You know what you need to do, right?
segments.ipa: /ju noʊ wʌt ju nid tu du raɪt/

segments.text: you either need to uh develop more an in more of an interest in the culture of whatever uh language you're learning in your case English.
segments.ipa: /ju ˈiðər nid tu ʌ dɪˈvɛləp mɔr æn ɪn mɔr ʌv æn ˈɪntrəst ɪn ðə ˈkʌltʃər ʌv ˌwʌˈtɛvər ʌ ˈlæŋɡwədʒ jʊr ˈlɝnɪŋ ɪn jɔr keɪs ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ/

segments.text: Uh you need to be patient, okay?
segments.ipa: /ʌ ju nid tu bi ˈpeɪʃənt ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: Be humble and challenge yourself, okay?
segments.ipa: /bi ˈhʌmbəl ənd ˈtʃæləndʒ jərˈsɛlf ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: Use content that's a little challenging for you so you can reach that next level. Okay?
segments.ipa: /jus ˈkɑntɛnt ðæts ə ˈlɪtəl ˈtʃæləndʒɪŋ fɔr ju soʊ ju kæn ritʃ ðæt nɛkst ˈlɛvəl ˌoʊˈkeɪ/

segments.text: So, if you want that challenging content, check out the links down below uh for my advanced episodes in my US Conversations podcast.
segments.ipa: /soʊ ɪf ju wɑnt ðæt ˈtʃæləndʒɪŋ ˈkɑntɛnt tʃɛk aʊt ðə lɪŋks daʊn bɪˈloʊ ʌ fɔr maɪ ədˈvænst ˈɛpəˌsoʊdz ɪn maɪ ʌs ˌkɑnvərˈseɪʃənz ˈpɔdˌkæst/

segments.text: Check those out.
segments.ipa: /tʃɛk ðoʊz aʊt/

segments.text: Those will be helpful for you. All right.
segments.ipa: /ðoʊz wɪl bi ˈhɛlpfəl fɔr ju ɔl raɪt/

segments.text: Thank you all for watching this video and I'll talk to you in the next
segments.ipa: /θæŋk ju ɔl fɔr ˈwɑtʃɪŋ ðɪs ˈvɪdioʊ ənd aɪl tɔk tu ju ɪn ðə nɛkst/
